blocks.text: Resource groups are the key factor in configuring Microsegmentation policies. Admins can create resource groups based on a combination of the resources added to them and a mix of dynamic criteria, including hosts, environments, and cloud tag data. To learn more, see About Resources.
The User-Defined Resource Groups page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View a summary of resource group data in your organization.
Configure, edit, and delete resource groups.
Take appropriate actions based on the resource group data displayed.
Discover insights about collective resource group data.

blocks.heading: About the User-Defined Resource Groups Page

blocks.text: On the User-Defined Resource Groups page (Zero Trust Cloud > Microsegmentation > Resource Groups), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Refresh the page to reflect the most current information.
Add a resource group.
Show or hide available columns.
Show or hide available filters.

Filter the information. Click the + icon to view additional filters. After configuring your preferred filters, click the button to apply the filters (e.g., Apply 1 filter, Apply 2 filters) and view the results. By default, no filters are applied.
See image.
View a list of all resource groups that are configured for your organization. For each resource group, you can see:
Name: The name of the resource group.
Resource Type: The type of resource group (Managed or Unmanaged).
Member Count: The number of resources in the resource group.
Click an individual resource group to view its complete information.
See image.
Edit a resource group.
Delete a resource group.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the System Resource Groups page.
Go to the ML Recommendations for Resource Groups page.
